BTEUP Re-evaluation Results for June Exams Released

The Board of Technical Education Uttar Pradesh (BTEUP) has released the re-evaluation results for examinations held in June. Candidates can check their updated marks and qualifying status by logging into the BTEUP student portal on the official website, bteup.ac.in.
